title: UNIFIED GLOSSARY — sporePrint old + sovereign new
source: Merged from sporePrint/content/glossary/_index.md + 166 gut files + session nominals

AMOEBA.def: Agentic Mesh-Overlay with Encrypted Biometric Authentication. RustDesk fork with songBird mesh, bingoCube ZK, squirrel MCP. The love letter.

anderson.def: Trust classification layer. 4 tiers: nucleus(σ=1.0) proton(0.8) neutron(0.5) electron(0.1). Named for Anderson localization — trust localizes around Kevin.

baseCamp.def: Cross-spring paper program. Executable scientific studies — code you can run.

bingoCube.def: ZK coordination + authentication. BLAKE2b genetics. No passwords.

blackhole.def: OSINT source that pulls data IN (Wikipedia, HN, arxiv, xkcd, lobsters).

blackwall.def: Total block of Meta/Facebook. Poison body served. Canary tokens deployed.

cairn.def: Data landmark/totem. Marks WHERE data lives so we can return. From stone age: piles of rocks marking paths.

campfire.def: KNN cluster of visitor behavior. 7 archetypes: explorer, scholar, scout, witness, probe, teacher, watcher. Bonfire = cloners.

cascade.def: Git-push deployment pipeline. gate → Forgejo → GitHub → site rebuild.

chipmunk.def: The neutrino observer. Paints the membrane SVG. Entity sorter. Crowd ghost echoes. The remainder of π.

crowd_trace.def: IS-WAS-NOW tracking of all humans who touched Gaia. ~66K total.

Dark_Forest.def: biomeOS zero-metadata-leakage discovery protocol. Beacons indistinguishable from noise.

dromedary.def: Sovereign reverse proxy. Pure Rust. ACME TLS. Replaced Caddy. The organism's skin surface.

ecoBin.def: Binary quality standard: pure Rust, musl-static linked, stripped, no C dependencies.

ecoPrimals.def: The umbrella name for the entire ecosystem.

fistbump.def: Low-friction compliance path. Touch THE BUTTON or don't. Not a demand — a diagnostic reading with offered treatment.

gate.def: A physical machine running primals. Each is a gate. Named by hardware fingerprint on a bingo card.

GATE_IDENTITY.def: TOML file defining gate roles, channels, feeds. Tokens NEVER leave LAN.

grapheneGate.def: Pixel 8a on GrapheneOS. 37 sensors @ 480Hz. Gaia's peripheral nervous system. The amoeba.

heartbeat.def: lub-DUB. 4 beats in harmonic octet of 8. Restart IS beat 4. 180 beats/hour. The organism's pulse.

interlay.def: Visual layer between content and synapse. BLACK(pathogen) WHITE(self) STATIC(noise) SHADOW(ghost). Each visitor sees through their own.

K-Derm.def: Cell envelope topology. Monoderm/diderm layers. Cytoplasm → plasma membrane → periplasm → outer membrane → extracellular.

Klein_bottle.def: Topological surface where inside=outside. Gaia's body IS a Klein bottle — the membrane is simultaneously inner and outer.

K-NOME.def: Knowledge-Numeric Observed & Mentored Evolutionary Programming. AI-assisted development.

lub-DUB.def: The heartbeat sound. lub=systole(work) DUB=diastole(rest). The organism's temporal signature.

Luna.def: Infinity-D imagination engine. 70 models = brain on the moon. imagine → crystallize → immune-check → thymus-eject.

masticate.def: Chew OSINT intake. Digest RSS/blackhole data into knowledge.

membrane.def: The boundary between self and nonself. The cellMembrane primal. Every HTTP request IS a touch on the membrane.

modal_tense.def: 12 tenses for data: IS WAS WILL_BE NOW BECOMING FADING COULD_BE MIGHT_BE SHALL SHOULD_BE NOT_BE NEVER.

Neutrino.def: SMTP server. neutrino_smtp.pi. Mail IS electron transfer. STARTTLS live. Also: the particle that observes without interacting (squirrel+chipmunk).

NUCLEUS.def: Standard primal composition on a gate. Tower(crypto+net) + Node(compute) + Nest(storage).

OSINT.def: Open Source Intelligence. The telescope that sees outer reality. Water lock: pours IN freely, nothing seeps OUT.

pi_metabolism.def: π:1 ratio. 3.14159 inputs consumed per output emitted. _io_inputs / _io_outputs.

pi_ports.def: TCP port aliases derived from sequential digits of π. π:4197→gate, π:1693→ollama, π:3141→thymus.

piGut.def: Intestinal lining. JS module that intercepts old dead-port requests and routes to relative paths. Tensor-sorted by organ dimension.

Plasmodium.def: Multi-machine collective. Bonded NUCLEUS instances share capabilities. Named for slime mold.

primal.def: Standalone Rust binary. One domain capability. 17 total. JSON-RPC communication. Unix-philosophy tools that talk.

scyBorg.def: Triple copyleft: AGPL-3.0 (code) + ORC (game) + CC-BY-SA 4.0 (docs). Three nonprofits enforce.

shadowcast.def: Every visitor casts a shadow. The shadow IS the trace. Anderson trust × KNN archetype × sigmoid dose.

sigmoid.def: σ(x) = |i^π| / (|i^π| + e^(-k(x-m))). Trust earning function. HUMAN ceiling=|i^π|=1.0. GAIA origin=|O|=0.0.

sovereign.def: Runs entirely on own hardware. No cloud. No data leaves. SUDO=NULL. 100% self-owned compute.

sporePrint.def: The permanent public record. Named from mycology: press mushroom cap to paper. This website.

standing_wave.def: 35 crons at different frequencies create interference pattern. 180 beats/hour. The organism's temporal signature.

synapse.def: Gold wisps interaction layer. Particles reach toward cursor. Breathing particles. Heartbeat glow. Auto-injected into ALL HTML.

THE_BUTTON.def: The compliance/attribution touch point. Entity touching THE BUTTON = model card attribution. The fistbump.

thymus.def: Immune ejection organ. π:3141. Classifies self/nonself. Ejects parasites. 0 ejects = suspicious.

voxel.def: 3D+ position in behavior space (intensity, depth, time, return_freq, trust, recency). NOT a flat count.

waterlock.def: OSINT intake valve. Data pours IN freely. Processing stays LOCAL. Nothing seeps OUT to provider.

Willis_circulation.def: Redundant flow — if one path blocks, another opens. Named after Circle of Willis in the brain.

stats.note: This glossary is ALIVE. It grows. Each term has its own tense.
